resolution.question: Does CEO Jane Zhao approve the Q3 performance bonus for the engineering team by September 15, 2026?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that CEO Jane Zhao actually approved the Q3 performance bonus for the engineering team before or on September 15, 2026. Otherwise resolve NO at the hard cutoff 2026-09-15T23:59:00-04:00.
